Sets out from the Shire
Gandalf acquisition
gandalf.sh and gandalf.py (Linux, macOS; local or over SSH) and Invoke-Gandalf.ps1 (Windows, as admin). Live state first, then files in order of volatility; locked ones straight off the NTFS volume. Once all is copied, every file is SHA-256 hashed into log.meta, which Elrond checks on arrival. The archive is encrypted; in Key mode the key rides home as <host>.shadowfax.key.
The Prancing Pony, Bree
Web UI and API :5687 · :5688
React front end and FastAPI back end: start jobs, upload or pick images, watch progress, read results, Ask Aulë, Pippin (threat intelligence), shared findings. Admins also see Aragorn.
Delving in Moria
Elrond worker Celery
Jobs arrive through Redis. The worker runs Elrond, and Elrond runs its tools as separate processes: Volatility 3, Plaso, Artemis, RegRipper, YARA, The Sleuth Kit.
Orthanc's palantír
SIEM Splunk · Elastic
--Splunk and --Elastic index the cooked artefacts, with Rowanholt's own Splunk app and Kibana dashboards. Local containers or remote servers.
The King in Minas Tirith
Aragorn administration
Andúril: Rowanholt's own containers (status, logs, restart; won't stop the worker mid-job). The lab: Linux targets, Tart and UTM VMs, test runs from the browser, Gandalf against seeded hosts, Mordor recordings.
Where the shadows lie
Mordor attack datasets
OTRF Security-Datasets (APT29 day 1 and 2, Atomic sets) and the lab's own recordings of Atomic Red Team tests. --Mordor ingests them as event logs, so detections and ATT&CK tagging can be checked against known attacks.
Under the Lonely Mountain
Case store the hoard
Postgres: users, jobs, history. Case directories on disk: raw/, cooked/, analysis/, mitre_techniques.txt, timelines, archives.

The Lands of Men
what Gandalf and Elrond read
Windows hosts
Event logs, registry and hives with logs, $MFT, $UsnJrnl, Prefetch, SRUM, Amcache, tasks, BITS, Search, Defender, browsers, memory
Linux hosts
Logs, journal, cron, systemd, PAM, sudoers, logins, histories, web roots, kernel modules, Docker and Kubernetes node state, memory (AVML)
macOS hosts
launchd and BTM items, unified-log export, TCC, KnowledgeC, quarantine, ExecPolicy, XProtect, Biome, browsers
Cloud
AWS, Azure and GCP: instances, disk snapshots, CloudTrail and activity logs; Kubernetes audit logs
Disk and memory images
E01, VMDK, raw and dd, VHD(X); memory dumps, hiberfil, pagefile. Straight to Elrond, no Gandalf needed.

What Arrives
every kind of evidence Elrond takes
Disk images
E01, VMDK, VHD(X), raw and dd; whole disks or single volumes.
Memory images
Raw dumps, AFF4, hiberfil.sys, pagefile.sys, MEMORY.DMP, a VM's .vmem.
Gandalf archives
Per-host archives from all three collectors, encrypted or not.
Event datasets
OTRF Security-Datasets (Mordor) and the lab's own recordings of Atomic tests.
Cloud
Instances' disk snapshots, CloudTrail and activity logs from AWS, Azure and GCP; Kubernetes audit logs.
The Rowan-ford
Identify and mount
Each image is mounted read-only: ewfmount for E01, qemu-nbd or guestmount for VMDK and VHD(X), losetup and kpartx for raw, ntfs-3g, HFS+ and APFS drivers for the file systems. The OS is read from what's on the volume. vshadowmount turns every shadow copy into a branch of its own. Memory images get their Volatility profile here and wait for processing.
THE WEST-ROAD · WINDOWS
disk images only
Collect
Hives with their .LOG1/.LOG2, NTUSER and UsrClass, event logs, $MFT, $UsnJrnl, $LogFile, prefetch, SRUM, Amcache, jump lists, the WMI repository, tasks, recycle bin, browsers, Outlook, hiberfil and pagefile.
raw/ to cooked/ JSON Lines
Process
Artemis parses $MFT, $UsnJrnl, event logs, prefetch, SRUM, jump lists, shimcache and Outlook; registry extractions for system and user hives and USB; WMI subscriptions carved from OBJECTS.DATA; UAL, ActivitiesCache, ETL, LNK, Defender logs, PCA, WER.
Volatility 3
Memory
windows.pslist, psscan, cmdline, netscan, malfind, svcscan, dlllist, handles, registry.hivelist and userassist; hiberfil.sys and MEMORY.DMP read as memory.
THE NORTH-WAY · LINUX
disk images only
Collect
/etc (passwd, group, shadow, sudoers, PAM, preload, profile), /var/log and the journal, cron, systemd units and generators, utmp/wtmp/btmp, wtmpdb and lastlog2, udev, autostart, web roots, histories, Docker and Kubernetes.
raw/ to cooked/ JSON Lines
Process
Logs, services and groups to JSON Lines; logins and failed logins; PAM, sudoers and preload flagged; udev, desktop and user units; kernel modules without a file; executables in /tmp and /dev/shm; web shells; bash, zsh and vim histories; containers flagged for what they can reach.
Volatility 3
Memory
linux.pslist, pstree, bash, lsof, malfind, lsmod, check_modules, check_syscall, check_idt, check_creds, tty_check.
THE ELVEN-PATH · MACOS
disk images only
Collect
LaunchAgents, LaunchDaemons and StartupItems, BTM, a unified-log export, TCC, KnowledgeC, quarantine, ExecPolicy, XProtect, Biome, notifications, emond, periodic, logs, Safari and Chrome, Mail.
raw/ to cooked/ JSON Lines
Process
Plists to JSON with persistence tagged; BTM items and SFL lists decoded (NSKeyedArchiver, bookmarks); SQLite databases read with their WAL; emond and periodic scripts; unified-log events; .emlx mail; zsh history.
Volatility 3
Memory
mac.pslist, psaux, bash, lsof, netstat, malfind, lsmod, check_syscall, check_sysctl, check_trap_table, kauth_scopes, trustedbsd.
snapshots become disk images
memory images, by the profile they were given
Gandalf archives are decrypted, checked against Gandalf's SHA-256 manifest and laid out as raw/: already collected, they join at Process
The Council
every host, whichever road it came by
Analyse
Keyword and YARA searches, IOC extraction, timestomping and alternate data streams in $MFT, masquerading and misplaced binaries, NSRL matching. --threatIntel matches the case and ranks groups by what matched; stacking ranks what few of the hosts have, with its reasons.
ATT&CK
Techniques tagged from artefacts, event-log rules and Mordor datasets into mitre_techniques.txt; a Navigator layer.
Timeline
Plaso (psteal) builds one super-timeline across every source of a host.
Export
--Splunk, --Elastic (Rowanholt's app and dashboards), --Navigator, and the case archive with its audit log.
event datasets: one host per computer, events into cooked/evt/
